    "E1.1",
    "E2.1"
  ],
  "reasons": [
    "The ₹15,000 bad debt is covered by the stated ₹20,000 provision. The excerpts direct that the loss be adjusted against the provision.",
    "A records the write-off by crediting Debtors, then debits the existing provision and credits Bad Debts."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Admission of Partner",
  "syllabus_topic": "Revaluation of assets at admission: treatment of bad debts against an existing provision",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "An existing provision for doubtful debts of ₹20,000 is present.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Debtors of ₹15,000 have turned bad and must be written off.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Bad-debt losses are adjusted against an existing provision; the write-off entry credits Debtors and the provision adjustment debits the provision and credits Bad Debts.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": [
        "E1.1",
        "E2.1"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "The second entry could create a separately required fresh provision, but no such requirement is given; it does not adjust this write-off against the existing provision.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "A direct Revaluation-to-Debtors entry could write off bad debts where no provision applies, but this stem states an existing provision.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "A debit to Bad Debts might recognize the loss, but crediting Revaluation neither reduces Debtors nor adjusts the existing provision.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],

      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 2,
        "evidence": "Options test whether the candidate distinguishes debtor write-off, provision adjustment, and revaluation entries."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 2,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "application",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": []
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "Bad debts A/c Dr. 1,000 31, 2017 To Sundry debtors 1,000 (Futher bad debts) (b) Provision for doubtful debts A/c Dr. 3,000 To Bad debts A/c 3,000 (Bad debts adjusted against the provision",
      "reason": "It credits debtors for the write-off and adjusts the bad-debt loss by debiting the existing provision."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Revaluation A/c Dr ₹15,000; To Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c ₹15,000.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "Provision for doubtful debts A/c Dr. 3,000 To Bad debts A/c 3,000 (Bad debts adjusted against the provision",
      "reason": "The second entry credits the provision instead of debiting it to adjust the existing provision against bad debts."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Revaluation A/c Dr ₹15,000; To Debtors A/c ₹15,000.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "When such a provision already exists, the loss due to bad debts during the current year are adjusted against the same",
      "reason": "It charges the bad-debt loss to Revaluation rather than adjusting it against the existing provision."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "To Revaluation A/c ₹15,000.",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "Bad debts A/c Dr. 1,000 31, 2017 To Sundry debtors 1,000 (Futher bad debts)",
      "reason": "A write-off credits Debtors; this entry credits Revaluation and therefore does not reduce the debtor balance."
    }
  ]
}
